messages:
Anna (AE): Hey team — HippoBank just asked for a 4‑week POC. Primary ask: secure document summarization + semantic search across internal policies. They want success criteria, an estimated timeline, a minimal endpoint set, and any enterprise blockers. Can you help scope? :slightly_smiling_face:
Sanjay (SE): @Anna quick q — will the PII be redacted pre-POC or do we need a private deployment for the trial?
Anna (AE): They prefer us to handle data in our infra if possible. But security will judge. Their legal prefers data not to leave their VPC if feasible.
Maria (PM): OK prioritize: 1) Summarization (policy Q&A), 2) Search + reranking, 3) simple RAG for narrow docs. Success metrics we should propose too.
Kevin (Eng): From infra POV: two viable POC modes — hosted with strict retention + customer NDA + encrypted storage, or Private (VPC peering / on‑prem). Private adds 2–4 weeks ops setup.
Lisa (Security): Heads up — we'll need completed security questionnaire items: encryption at rest, KMS integration, SOC2, data residency, audit logs, and whether model traces are retained. Also need SSO/SCIM support.
Sanjay (SE): Draft minimal endpoint list for POC:```
POST /v1/summarize  -> short/long variants
POST /v1/embeddings/search -> upsert + query
POST /v1/rerank -> returns ordered doc ids
```Keep auth simple for now (API key scoped to POC).
Anna (AE): Good. Can we suggest evaluation and pass/fail criteria?
Maria (PM): Proposal: success = all five checks met:
1) Quality: average ROUGE-L on held prompts >= baseline (customer to provide 30 canonical prompts) OR human accept rate >= 85% on 50 sampled outputs.
2) Search relevance: MRR >= 0.7 or retrieval recall@5 >= 0.8 on their eval set.
3) Latency: p95 generation < 600ms for short summaries (<256 tokens) on Dedicated or hosted with SLA.
4) Cost: estimated <= $X per 100k tokens (TBD with pricing).
5) Security/compliance: agreed DPA, SOC2 evidence, and either VPC peering or documented data-retention policy <= 30 days.
Sanjay (SE): For evals, ask HippoBank to supply: 
- 30 representative prompts for summaries (gold answers optional)
- 200 query/doc pairs for search eval or at least 50 for a lightweight test
We can run automatic metrics + one manual round.
Kevin (Eng): Timeline sketch (4 weeks):
Week 0: Kickoff + security questionnaire + sample data
Week 1: Data ingestion + embedding index + baseline search
Week 2: Summarization endpoint + prompt tuning + first eval
Week 3: Reranking + latency tuning + QA
Week 4: Final eval, review, export configs + handover
Anna (AE): Budget/price asks from procurement will come. Can we provide a rough hosted estimate vs dedicated seat?
Kevin (Eng): Rough numbers: hosted (pay-as-you-go) for this workload ~ $2–5k for 4 weeks depending on volume. Dedicated/reserved node for POC (small gpus) ~ $8–12k setup plus infra. I'll get a precise quote after we know token volume and concurrency.
Lisa (Security): Enterprise blockers to flag now: SSO, data residency (EU for them), strict logging/audit requirements, legal redlines on model use. If they require no data to leave VPC, Private deployment likely mandatory.
Sanjay (SE): Prompt templates I'll start with (example):```
System: You are a compliance assistant.
User: Summarize the following policy section focusing on obligations for external vendors.
<document_chunk>
```We should include temperature control, max tokens, and stop sequences in config.
Anna (AE): Action items: 1) Ask HippoBank for eval prompts + sample docs; 2) Send security questionnaire; 3) Provide rough pricing ranges; 4) Confirm timeline. I'll coordinate.
Maria (PM): I'll prepare the acceptance checklist and a lightweight evaluation harness (script + metrics) we can run. Will need sample data by EOD Fri to hit Week 1.
Kevin (Eng): I'll draft the POC infra choices and exact cost calc, plus a one-page ops runbook for private vs hosted.
Lisa (Security): I'll attach the standard security packet and list of required evidence. Note: SCIM/SSO integration will add ~1 week if they require automatic provisioning.
POC-bot: New ticket created: POC-4289 HippoBank — initial checklist attached.
Sanjay (SE): One more ask: clarify expected concurrency (QPS) and document size distribution (avg tokens per doc). Those change batching and cost significantly.
Anna (AE): I'll get concurrency and sample sizes from them in next call. Meeting scheduled Tue 14:00.
Maria (PM): Perfect — once we have samples I'll seed the eval harness and share an example report.
Kevin (Eng): If they want private quickstart, we can offer a thin VM + DB setup that reduces ops time — will outline in quote.
Anna (AE): Great team. I'll update HippoBank with this scoping and send the questionnaire. cc @Sanjay @Maria @Kevin @Lisa :thumbsup:
Sanjay (SE): Sounds good. I'll prep the sample prompt set template and a short doc on expected metrics.
Lisa (Security): I'll pre-fill common answers we can reuse for procurement.
Maria (PM): I'll track deliverables in the POC ticket.
Anna (AE): Thanks all.
